equivalence.finalWordingChange: After the browser suites, the unconditional shared-save note hint was replaced with neutral guidance. Its toast now distinguishes failed local saving from saved-on-device. Exact base-anchor application and Python syntax passed; no persistence logic changed.
equivalence.scope: Equivalence covers the persistence JavaScript and native scroll guard, not the entire HTML or other release components.

privacy: Only test labels, booleans, counts and source hashes retained. No native records, field values, screenshots, source attachments or credentials.
